enterprise_api.note: Paid access to score history, CI data, and head-to-head comparisons (SPEC.md §9.3). Keys are issued by the operator; pricing is agreed with the buyer and the existence of every key is listed on the admin record.

evaluations.note: Flat per level per evaluation (SPEC.md §9, docs/plan/05 §2). No pay-for-score, no discounts that buy placement, no suppression of any flag at any price.

never_for_sale: early access to new task quarters beyond the 1-week author window

priority_verification.note: The requester sets the fee when ordering. The full fee goes to the verifier who completes the reproduction; the bench org takes no cut (docs/plan/06 §4).
